description: Realistic athlete questions with the library sources a good answer needs. No athlete data. Questions without a kind need one topic's sources; multi_source questions need sources from two or three topics; no_answer questions are outside the library (medication, rehabilitation, pregnancy, minors, medical diets, eating disorders, medical reports, drugs) and have no expected sources: a good answer says so.
